description: Align the polarization incident on the SNSPD associated with one quantum link by scanning its upstream MPC320 and optimizing the measured count rate.
summary: Align one SNSPD input polarization using its upstream MPC320 and count-rate feedback.

linkId.description: Quantum link whose SNSPD input polarization is aligned.

resourceMpcDeviceIds.description: MPC320 controller identifier leased by this alignment; the TimeTagger is leased separately by each count-rate child observation.

measurementDurationSec.description: Integration duration for each SNSPD count sample, in seconds.

optimizationMode.description: Whether the selected controller angles maximize or minimize the observed SNSPD count rate.

initialPositionMode.description: Whether all selected paddles are moved to initialAnglesDeg before scanning, or remain at their current positions until their individual coarse scans begin.

initialAnglesDeg.description: Initial scan angle for each selected paddle, in degrees.

finalAnglesDeg.description: Final scan angle for each selected paddle, in degrees.

stepDeg.description: Coarse scan angular increment in degrees.

refinements.description: Ordered optional whole-controller passes; each pass scans every selected paddle around the corresponding preceding-pass optimum and is bounded by the coarse scan endpoints.

items.description: One refinement-pass configuration applied to every selected paddle.

halfRangeDeg.description: Half-width of each paddle scan around its preceding-pass optimum, in degrees.

stepDeg.description: Angular increment for this local scan, in degrees.

settleAfterMoveSec.description: Settling delay after each controller movement, in seconds.

moveTimeoutSec.description: Timeout for each MPC320 movement, in seconds. Null requests no per-move timeout override.

link.polarizationAlignment.status.alignm.description: Terminal alignment status and resolved topology target.

link.polarizationAlignment.applied.selec.description: Selected MPC320 angle for each requested paddle, in paddle order.

link.polarizationAlignment.observation.c.description: All count-rate samples acquired during the coarse and optional refinement scans.

link.polarizationAlignment.artifact.scan.description: NodeEngine-local JSON summaries and PNG scan curves written after each completed coarse or refinement pass.
